channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: Major study finds Americans bear overwhelming cost of Trump’s tariffs
item.description: An analysis of more than 25 million shipment records shows US consumers and businesses pay 96 percent of tariff costs, contradicting repeated claims that foreign exporters foot the bill.

item.title: Musk’s $10 million Senate donation reignites debate over billionaire influence in elections
item.description: Elon Musk’s $10 million super PAC donation to a MAGA challenger seeking Mitch McConnell’s seat renews scrutiny of campaign finance law and billionaire influence in U.S. elections.

item.title: Trump escalates Greenland standoff with tariffs and military threats as Europe pushes back
item.description: Denmark and multiple NATO allies deploy troops and reject coercion after Donald Trump declares there can be “no going back” on his demand to take control of Greenland.

item.title: How much ego-serving cataclysm must MAGA Trumpism wreak—before fierce adversaries resist?
item.description: Looking older, bedraggled and more deranged, Trump is running out of laws, rules, thresholds, institutions, alliances and Congressionally-mandated programs to burn down.
